newsitem.title: GERMANY: Pro Sieben sees float over 10 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Pro Sieben sees float over 10 times oversubscribed.

text.p: Shares in German television channel Pro Sieben AG, due to be floated on the stock market on Monday, are likely to be more than 10 times oversubscribed, a spokesman for the company said on Thursday.
The exact degree of oversubscription was not known yet, the spokesman said.

The price range for the preference shares, which have attracted intense interest amid huge publicity in Germany, is 66 to 72 marks, well below the price of around 100 marks which has been quoted on the grey, or pre-official trade, market.
The final offer price will be made known on Saturday July 5 during the ProSieben nightly news broadcast at 1730 GMT and shares begin trading on July 7.
The issue is being managed by a banking consortium that is led by BHF-Bank AG, Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG, and Salomon Brothers.
